brief:
Israeli forces killed four Palestinians in the last 24 hours across northern and southern Gaza, Al Jazeera and the Wafa news agency reported, citing medical sources. Two of those killed in the latest strikes were a teenage girl and another Palestinian in separate incidents in the two regions.

The deaths mark a continuation of ongoing Israeli military operations across Gaza.
dek: Israel kills four Palestinians in last 24 hours, including teenage girl Two more Palestinians, including a teenage girl, were killed by Israeli fire in areas in northern and southern Gaza, Al Jazeera and Wafa news agency report, citing medical sources.
title: Israeli fire kills four Palestinians including teenage girl
